wave: Wave C5.4 — Rider Trace & Local Stop Verification
governance: Ponytail governs implementation simplicity; O-TRAVELZ truth/provenance rules override any simplification.

findings.finding: Avoid complex streaming pipelines (Kafka, Redis, Celery); use minimal relational tables within existing SQLite/Postgres runtime.
findings.action: Define transit_ride_sessions, transit_ride_samples, transit_stop_observations in SQLAlchemy reusing base conventions.

findings.finding: Do not add Valhalla/OSRM daemons; reuse existing polyline distance and bounding box helpers from DeterministicGeometryEngine.
findings.action: Implement pure-python deterministic trace matcher and cleaner using existing coordinates and regional envelopes.

findings.finding: Avoid complex Dempster-Shafer belief engines; use clear deterministic state ladder (OBSERVED_ONCE, COMMUNITY_SUPPORTED, PROMOTION_REVIEW_READY).
findings.action: Implement explicit counting gates: >=3 independent sessions, >=2 contributors, <=50m spatial cluster dispersion.

findings.finding: Avoid gamification, leaderboards, and interactive typing while bus is moving.
findings.action: Single-tap actions only: Start ride, Bus stopped here, Boarded, Alighted, Finish.

findings.finding: Do not store email, phone, or raw user ID in observation tables.
findings.action: Enforce pseudonymous session identity via rotating salted hash (session_hash).

findings.finding: Ponytail might suggest sharing test trace formats directly with staging registry.
findings.action: Strictly reject: test traces must be flagged TEST_FIXTURE_ONLY and structurally blocked from production observation registry.

findings.finding: Reuse observation API endpoint and schema with LOCAL_CONFIRMATION rather than building a separate survey service.
findings.action: Support observation_type LOCAL_CONFIRMATION with optional GPS/photo evidence.
